+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear;
+
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.modules.entity.damage.Damage;
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
+import java.math.BigDecimal;
+import java.util.*;
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
+
+class NativeAffixBlockCostSystemTest {
+    private final GearCatalog catalog=GearCatalog.load();
+
+    private GearEffectSnapshot guard(double value){
+        var definition=catalog.affix("WA-083");
+        var roll=new GearInstance.AffixRoll(definition.id(),definition.side(),definition.exclusionGroup(),
+                1,value,new GearRequirements.Gate(1,Map.of()),definition.name(),definition.name());
+        var item=GearInstance.authoredQa(catalog.base("gm.shield_copper.h"),UUID.randomUUID(),99,1000,
+                GearRarity.UNCOMMON,List.of(roll),BigDecimal.ZERO);
+        return new GearEffectSnapshot(List.of(item));
+    }
+    private static Damage block(){
+        var damage=new Damage(Damage.NULL_SOURCE,0,10f);
+        damage.putMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED,true);
+        return damage;
+    }
+    @Test void nativeBlockDebitMultiplierIsChangedExactlyOnce(){
+        var snapshot=guard(15);
+        var hit=block();hit.putMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER,2f);
+        assertTrue(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(hit,snapshot));
+        assertEquals(1.7f,hit.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER),.00001f);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(hit,snapshot));
+        assertEquals(1.7f,hit.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER),.00001f);
+    }
+    @Test void noAffixFailedBlockAndCancelledDamageRetainNativeCost(){
+        var noAffix=block();assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(noAffix,GearEffectSnapshot.EMPTY));
+        assertNull(noAffix.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER));
+        var failed=new Damage(Damage.NULL_SOURCE,0,10f);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(failed,guard(15)));
+        assertNull(failed.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER));
+        var cancelled=block();cancelled.setCancelled(true);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(cancelled,guard(15)));
+    }
+}

+/** WA-083: alter the authenticated native block debit before DamageStamina consumes it. */
+public final class NativeAffixBlockCostSystem extends DamageEventSystem {

+            ignored->false,false,"Hywind:AffixBlockCostApplied",com.hypixel.hytale.codec.Codec.BOOLEAN);
+
+    @Override public SystemGroup<EntityStore> getGroup(){return DamageModule.get().getInspectDamageGroup();}
+    @Override public Query<EntityStore> getQuery(){return Query.and(PlayerRef.getComponentType(),DamageDataComponent.getComponentType());}
+    @Override public Set<Dependency<EntityStore>> getDependencies(){return Set.of(
+            new SystemDependency<>(Order.BEFORE,DamageSystems.DamageStamina.class));}

+                                 CommandBuffer<EntityStore> buffer,Damage damage){
+        if(damage.isCancelled()||!Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED)))return;
+        var actor=chunk.getReferenceTo(index);
+        var data=chunk.getComponent(index,DamageDataComponent.getComponentType());
+        if(data==null||data.getCurrentWielding()==null||data.getCurrentWielding().getStaminaCost()==null)return;
+        var held=InventoryComponent.getItemInHand(store,actor);
+        if(!GearNativeItems.managed(held)||!GearNativeItems.canUse(held,actor,store))return;
+        GearInstance item;
+        try{item=GearNativeItems.read(held);}catch(RuntimeException invalid){return;}
+        var snapshot=GearNativeItems.effects(actor,store).snapshot();
+        if(snapshot.items().stream().noneMatch(valid->valid.identity().equals(item.identity())))return;
+        apply(damage,snapshot.forItem(item.identity()));
+    }
+
+    /** Same mutation used by the registered native system; callable with controlled legal snapshots. */
+    public static boolean apply(Damage damage,GearEffectSnapshot guard){
+        if(damage.isCancelled()||!Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED))
+                ||Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(APPLIED)))return false;
+        double reduction=guard.percent(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.BLOCK_COST);
+        if(reduction<=0)return false;
+        float prior=damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER)==null
+                ?1f:damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER);
+        if(!Float.isFinite(prior)||prior<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid native block multiplier");
+        damage.putMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER,(float)(prior*Math.max(0,1-reduction)));
+        damage.putMetaObject(APPLIED,true);
+        return true;
+    }

+    private static final MetaKey<Boolean> APPLIED=Damage.META_REGISTRY.registerMetaObject(
+            ignored->false,false,"Hywind:AffixBlockCostApplied",com.hypixel.hytale.codec.Codec.BOOLEAN);
+
+    @Override public SystemGroup<EntityStore> getGroup(){return DamageModule.get().getInspectDamageGroup();}
+    @Override public Query<EntityStore> getQuery(){return Query.and(PlayerRef.getComponentType(),DamageDataComponent.getComponentType());}
+    @Override public Set<Dependency<EntityStore>> getDependencies(){return Set.of(
+            new SystemDependency<>(Order.BEFORE,DamageSystems.DamageStamina.class));}
+
+    @Override public void handle(int index,ArchetypeChunk<EntityStore> chunk,Store<EntityStore> store,
+                                 CommandBuffer<EntityStore> buffer,Damage damage){
+        if(damage.isCancelled()||!Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED)))return;
+        var actor=chunk.getReferenceTo(index);
+        var data=chunk.getComponent(index,DamageDataComponent.getComponentType());
+        if(data==null||data.getCurrentWielding()==null||data.getCurrentWielding().getStaminaCost()==null)return;
+        var held=InventoryComponent.getItemInHand(store,actor);
+        if(!GearNativeItems.managed(held)||!GearNativeItems.canUse(held,actor,store))return;
+        GearInstance item;
+        try{item=GearNativeItems.read(held);}catch(RuntimeException invalid){return;}
+        var snapshot=GearNativeItems.effects(actor,store).snapshot();
+        if(snapshot.items().stream().noneMatch(valid->valid.identity().equals(item.identity())))return;
+        apply(damage,snapshot.forItem(item.identity()));
+    }
+
+    /** Same mutation used by the registered native system; callable with controlled legal snapshots. */
+    public static boolean apply(Damage damage,GearEffectSnapshot guard){
+        if(damage.isCancelled()||!Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED))
+                ||Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(APPLIED)))return false;
+        double reduction=guard.percent(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.BLOCK_COST);
+        if(reduction<=0)return false;
+        float prior=damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER)==null
+                ?1f:damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER);
+        if(!Float.isFinite(prior)||prior<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid native block multiplier");
+        damage.putMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER,(float)(prior*Math.max(0,1-reduction)));
+        damage.putMetaObject(APPLIED,true);
+        return true;
+    }
+}

package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear;

import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.difficulty.DifficultyId;

/** Persisted historical budgets remain readable. New drops use legalNewBudget. */
public enum GearRarity {
    COMMON("Normal", "#ffffff", "Common", 0, 0, 1),
    UNCOMMON("Magic", "#1d4dff", "Uncommon", 1, 1, 1),
    RARE("Rare", "#FFFF00", "Rare", 2, 3, 10),
    VERY_RARE("Rare", "#FFFF00", "Epic", 4, 5, 35),
    LEGENDARY("Legendary", "#ff9100", "Legendary", 6, 6, 60),
    NORMAL("Normal", "#ffffff", "Common", 0, 0, 1),
    MAGIC("Magic", "#1d4dff", "Uncommon", 1, 1, 1);

    public static final String AFFIX_COLOR = "#1d4dff";
    public final String label, color, nativeParticleTier;
    public final int minAffixes, maxAffixes, minimumLevel;
    GearRarity(String label, String color, String nativeTier, int min, int max, int level) {
        this.label=label; this.color=color; nativeParticleTier=nativeTier;
        minAffixes=min; maxAffixes=max; minimumLevel=level;
    }
    public String particlePath() {
        String tier=quality()==GearQuality.MAGIC?"Rare":"Common";
        return "Particles/Drop/"+tier+"/Drop_"+tier+".particlesystem";
    }
    public GearQuality quality(){return switch(this){case COMMON,NORMAL->GearQuality.NORMAL;case UNCOMMON,MAGIC->GearQuality.MAGIC;default->GearQuality.RARE;};}
    public String qualityAsset(){if(this==LEGENDARY)return "RPG_Gear_Legendary";return switch(quality()){case NORMAL->"RPG_Gear_Common";case MAGIC->"RPG_Gear_Rare";case RARE->"RPG_Gear_RandomRare";default->throw new IllegalStateException();};}
    public boolean eligible(int itemLevel, DifficultyId era) {
        return itemLevel>=minimumLevel && itemLevel<=99 && (this!=LEGENDARY || era==DifficultyId.HELL);
    }
    public boolean legalBudget(int prefixes, int suffixes) {
        if(prefixes<0 || suffixes<0) return false;
        if(legalNewBudget(prefixes,suffixes)) return true;
        // Version-one saves were issued under the three-band profile. Decode them
        // unchanged; generation never calls this compatibility branch.
        return switch(this) {
            case MAGIC -> prefixes+suffixes==1 || prefixes==1 && suffixes==1;
            case RARE -> prefixes>=1 && suffixes>=1 && prefixes<=3 && suffixes<=3 && prefixes+suffixes>=2 && prefixes+suffixes<=6;
            default -> false;
        };
    }
    public boolean legalNewBudget(int prefixes,int suffixes) {
        if(prefixes<0 || suffixes<0) return false;
        return switch(this) {
            case COMMON,NORMAL -> prefixes==0 && suffixes==0;
            case UNCOMMON,MAGIC -> prefixes+suffixes==1;
            case RARE -> prefixes>=1 && suffixes>=1 && prefixes<=2 && suffixes<=2 && prefixes+suffixes<=3;
            case VERY_RARE -> prefixes>=1 && suffixes>=1 && prefixes<=3 && suffixes<=3 && prefixes+suffixes>=4 && prefixes+suffixes<=5;

+        var snapshot=GearNativeItems.effects(actor,store).snapshot();
+        if(snapshot.items().stream().noneMatch(valid->valid.identity().equals(item.identity())))return;
+        apply(damage,snapshot.forItem(item.identity()));
+    }
+
+    /** Same mutation used by the registered native system; callable with controlled legal snapshots. */
+    public static boolean apply(Damage damage,GearEffectSnapshot guard){
+        if(damage.isCancelled()||!Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED))
+                ||Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(APPLIED)))return false;
+        double reduction=guard.percent(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.BLOCK_COST);
+        if(reduction<=0)return false;
+        float prior=damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER)==null
+                ?1f:damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER);
+        if(!Float.isFinite(prior)||prior<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid native block multiplier");
+        damage.putMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER,(float)(prior*Math.max(0,1-reduction)));
+        damage.putMetaObject(APPLIED,true);
+        return true;
+    }
+}

+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear;
+
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.modules.entity.damage.Damage;
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
+import java.math.BigDecimal;
+import java.util.*;
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
+
+class NativeAffixBlockCostSystemTest {
+    private final GearCatalog catalog=GearCatalog.load();
+
+    private GearEffectSnapshot guard(double value){
+        var definition=catalog.affix("WA-083");
+        var roll=new GearInstance.AffixRoll(definition.id(),definition.side(),definition.exclusionGroup(),
+                1,value,new GearRequirements.Gate(1,Map.of()),definition.name(),definition.name());
+        var item=GearInstance.authoredQa(catalog.base("gm.battleaxe_adamantite.h"),UUID.randomUUID(),99,1000,
+                GearRarity.UNCOMMON,List.of(roll),BigDecimal.ZERO);
+        return new GearEffectSnapshot(List.of(item));
+    }
+    private static Damage block(){
+        var damage=new Damage(Damage.NULL_SOURCE,0,10f);
+        damage.putMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED,true);
+        return damage;
+    }
+    @Test void nativeBlockDebitMultiplierIsChangedExactlyOnce(){

+        var hit=block();hit.putMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER,2f);

+        assertNull(noAffix.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER));
+        var failed=new Damage(Damage.NULL_SOURCE,0,10f);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(failed,guard(15)));
+        assertNull(failed.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER));
+        var cancelled=block();cancelled.setCancelled(true);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(cancelled,guard(15)));

This confirms the pre-debit seam used by `NativeAffixBlockCostSystem`.
+- Main owner: after confirming complete guard-source attribution and testing the registered ECS path, add `getEntityStoreRegistry().registerSystem(new com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.NativeAffixBlockCostSystem());` beside the other damage systems in `HyArpgPlugin.java` (near `ReactionObserver`). Ordering is declared in the system dependency. Retain `GearAffixRuntime.ENABLED` until all production cases and tests pass; then include WA-083 through the main owner's capability decision. Do not enable WA-083 merely because the adapter compiles.
+- Main owner: shield bindings in `rpg/gear/native-bindings-v1.json` are presently `BLOCKED_WITH_REASON`; `gm.shield_copper.h` has no managed carrier. A complete WA-083 requires mapped shield carriers and an authoritative way to identify the source hand for `getCurrentWielding()`, including utility/offhand. The adapter currently fails closed whenever a utility item is active; it must not be presented as covering shields.
+- Combat owner: WA-008 needs immutable action plus animation timeline profiles at accepted native chain start; WA-014 needs authored sweep geometry, terrain clipping and shared victim ledger; WA-015/016 need speed and accumulated path-distance changes in `ManagedGearProjectile`; WA-138 needs real Defense rating timed modifier, lock and native Filter integration. WA-084 requires a preserved ordinary and critical component pair on the hit envelope before Filter; current `HytaleDamageMetadata` contains only one premitigation scalar. WA-138/084 cannot infer these values from `Damage.getAmount()`.
+- Status/resources owner: WA-081 must project the strongest Slow after reduction into one exact movement modifier; the current `HytaleAreaStatuses.synchronize` maps Slow to discrete `RPG_Chill_*` assets, so simply scaling the status value would not prove a 40% to 32% native movement outcome. WA-082 requires an attacker-classified hostile displacement request before the safe collision solver. Self movement must retain its baseline. WA-083 native blocked-hit debit must be checked against the resources owner's event ordering and guard break.

The requested WA-138 is Riveting/Armor Break as its individual card states. Genuine offhand contact still needs an audited registered profile and a source-item snapshot, not a scalar extra hit.
+
+## Proven missing boundaries
+
+- **D10 / WA-153:** `DamageSystems.DamageArmor` on the installed JAR checks `DamageCause.isDurabilityLoss()`, picks an unbroken armor slot with native RNG, then calls `ItemUtils.decreaseItemStackDurability` directly. No cancellable per-item pre-debit event is exposed there. Managed weapon assets also contain `DurabilityLossOnHit` (e.g. battleaxe 0.45). A correct managed-carrier replacement must account for weapon contact, armor damage, guard, permissible tool use and death loss before disabling any native producer. Neither a post-debit refund nor a universal event was introduced. A complete design must replace every affected debit at its producer and preserve stock/unaﬃxed behavior.
+- **D11 / WA-155:** installed `ColorLight.radius` is a `byte`; `DynamicLight` exposes `getColorLight`/`setColorLight`, and `DynamicLightSystems.Setup` copies `PersistentDynamicLight` into `DynamicLight`. Thus 0.01 m exactness is not available directly from this representation. The radius-to-metre scale and interaction with held light still require calibration and actor-owned composition before any projection can be enabled.
+- **WA-156:** `HytaleGearLoot.scanStockPickup` is a copied-save, protected QA stock transfer and `autoPickup` is for managed equipment projections. Neither is a general currency/material claim path. The installed native `PlayerItemEntityPickupSystem` owns ordinary pickup; `InteractivelyPickupItemEvent` only carries a stack, not a player-specific reach override. No safe allowlisted claim/LOS/capacity transaction exists in this owner for expanded reach, so no radius mutation or synthetic admission was added.
+- **WA-152:** `EarnedReward` and `RpgPlayerState` have no currency field/remainder, and `HytaleEncounterRewards` currently sends XP/insight/mastery through `RpgLoadoutService.awardEarned/awardGenerated`. There is no eligible currency pot to bonus there. Main owner must add durable owner/currency amount and fractional remainder to the **same** deduplicated reward receipt/state before this class can apply D09. Do not pay at pickup or invent a separate mutable counter.

+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear;
+
+import com.hypixel.hytale.component.*;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.component.dependency.*;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.component.query.Query;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.entity.damage.DamageDataComponent;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.inventory.InventoryComponent;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.modules.entity.damage.*;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.universe.PlayerRef;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.universe.world.storage.EntityStore;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.meta.MetaKey;
+import java.util.Set;
+
+/** WA-083: alter the authenticated native block debit before DamageStamina consumes it. */
+public final class NativeAffixBlockCostSystem extends DamageEventSystem {
+    private static final MetaKey<Boolean> APPLIED=Damage.META_REGISTRY.registerMetaObject(
+            ignored->false,false,"Hywind:AffixBlockCostApplied",com.hypixel.hytale.codec.Codec.BOOLEAN);
+
+    @Override public SystemGroup<EntityStore> getGroup(){return DamageModule.get().getInspectDamageGroup();}
+    @Override public Query<EntityStore> getQuery(){return Query.and(PlayerRef.getComponentType(),DamageDataComponent.getComponentType());}
+    @Override public Set<Dependency<EntityStore>> getDependencies(){return Set.of(
+            new SystemDependency<>(Order.BEFORE,DamageSystems.DamageStamina.class));}
+
+    @Override public void handle(int index,ArchetypeChunk<EntityStore> chunk,Store<EntityStore> store,
+                                 CommandBuffer<EntityStore> buffer,Damage damage){
+        if(damage.isCancelled()||!Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED)))return;
+        var actor=chunk.getReferenceTo(index);
+        var data=chunk.getComponent(index,DamageDataComponent.getComponentType());
+        if(data==null||data.getCurrentWielding()==null||data.getCurrentWielding().getStaminaCost()==null)return;
+        var held=InventoryComponent.getItemInHand(store,actor);
+        // CurrentWielding does not expose its source hand. With a utility item active,
+        // attribution to the hotbar item would be ambiguous; leave native cost intact.
+        var utility=store.getComponent(actor,InventoryComponent.Utility.getComponentType());
+        if(utility!=null&&utility.getActiveItem()!=null&&!utility.getActiveItem().isEmpty())return;
+        if(!GearNativeItems.managed(held)||!GearNativeItems.canUse(held,actor,store))return;
+        GearInstance item;
+        try{item=GearNativeItems.read(held);}catch(RuntimeException invalid){return;}
+        var snapshot=GearNativeItems.effects(actor,store).snapshot();
+        if(snapshot.items().stream().noneMatch(valid->valid.identity().equals(item.identity())))return;
+        apply(damage,snapshot.forItem(item.identity()));
+    }
+
+    /** Same mutation used by the registered native system; callable with controlled legal snapshots. */
+    public static boolean apply(Damage damage,GearEffectSnapshot guard){
+        if(damage.isCancelled()||!Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED))
+                ||Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(APPLIED)))return false;
+        double reduction=guard.percent(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.BLOCK_COST);
+        if(reduction<=0)return false;
+        float prior=damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER)==null
+                ?1f:damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER);
+        if(!Float.isFinite(prior)||prior<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid native block multiplier");
+        damage.putMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER,(float)(prior*Math.max(0,1-reduction)));
+        damage.putMetaObject(APPLIED,true);
+        return true;
+    }
+}

+        if(damage.isCancelled()||!Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED)))return;
+        var actor=chunk.getReferenceTo(index);
+        var data=chunk.getComponent(index,DamageDataComponent.getComponentType());
+        if(data==null||data.getCurrentWielding()==null||data.getCurrentWielding().getStaminaCost()==null)return;
+        var held=InventoryComponent.getItemInHand(store,actor);
+        // CurrentWielding does not expose its source hand. With a utility item active,
+        // attribution to the hotbar item would be ambiguous; leave native cost intact.
+        var utility=store.getComponent(actor,InventoryComponent.Utility.getComponentType());
+        if(utility!=null&&utility.getActiveItem()!=null&&!utility.getActiveItem().isEmpty())return;
+        if(!GearNativeItems.managed(held)||!GearNativeItems.canUse(held,actor,store))return;
+        GearInstance item;
+        try{item=GearNativeItems.read(held);}catch(RuntimeException invalid){return;}
+        var snapshot=GearNativeItems.effects(actor,store).snapshot();
+        if(snapshot.items().stream().noneMatch(valid->valid.identity().equals(item.identity())))return;
+        apply(damage,snapshot.forItem(item.identity()));
+    }
+
+    /** Same mutation used by the registered native system; callable with controlled legal snapshots. */
+    public static boolean apply(Damage damage,GearEffectSnapshot guard){
+        if(damage.isCancelled()||!Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED))
+                ||Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(APPLIED)))return false;
+        double reduction=guard.percent(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.BLOCK_COST);
+        if(reduction<=0)return false;
+        float prior=damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER)==null
+                ?1f:damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER);
+        if(!Float.isFinite(prior)||prior<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid native block multiplier");
+        damage.putMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER,(float)(prior*Math.max(0,1-reduction)));
+        damage.putMetaObject(APPLIED,true);
+        return true;
+    }
+}

+- Installed `pre-release` server `HytaleServer.jar` was inspected with `javap`. `DamageSystems.DamageStamina` runs in `DamageModule.getInspectDamageGroup()`, tests `Damage.BLOCKED`, computes the base block stamina cost, multiplies by `Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER`, then calls `EntityStatMap.subtractStatValue`. This confirms the pre-debit seam used by `NativeAffixBlockCostSystem`.
+- Main owner: after confirming complete guard-source attribution and testing the registered ECS path, add `getEntityStoreRegistry().registerSystem(new com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.NativeAffixBlockCostSystem());` beside the other damage systems in `HyArpgPlugin.java` (near `ReactionObserver`). Ordering is declared in the system dependency. Retain `GearAffixRuntime.ENABLED` until all production cases and tests pass; then include WA-083 through the main owner's capability decision. Do not enable WA-083 merely because the adapter compiles.
+- Main owner: shield bindings in `rpg/gear/native-bindings-v1.json` are presently `BLOCKED_WITH_REASON`; `gm.shield_copper.h` has no managed carrier. A complete WA-083 requires mapped shield carriers and an authoritative way to identify the source hand for `getCurrentWielding()`, including utility/offhand. The adapter currently fails closed whenever a utility item is active; it must not be presented as covering shields.
+- Combat owner: WA-008 needs immutable action plus animation timeline profiles at accepted native chain start; WA-014 needs authored sweep geometry, terrain clipping and shared victim ledger; WA-015/016 need speed and accumulated path-distance changes in `ManagedGearProjectile`; WA-138 needs real Defense rating timed modifier, lock and native Filter integration. WA-084 requires a preserved ordinary and critical component pair on the hit envelope before Filter; current `HytaleDamageMetadata` contains only one premitigation scalar. WA-138/084 cannot infer these values from `Damage.getAmount()`.
+- Status/resources owner: WA-081 must project the strongest Slow after reduction into one exact movement modifier; the current `HytaleAreaStatuses.synchronize` maps Slow to discrete `RPG_Chill_*` assets, so simply scaling the status value would not prove a 40% to 32% native movement outcome. WA-082 requires an attacker-classified hostile displacement request before the safe collision solver. Self movement must retain its baseline. WA-083 native blocked-hit debit must be checked against the resources owner's event ordering and guard break.

The requested WA-138 is Riveting/Armor Break as its individual card states. Genuine offhand contact still needs an audited registered profile and a source-item snapshot, not a scalar extra hit.

+## Proven missing boundaries
+
+- **D10 / WA-153:** `DamageSystems.DamageArmor` on the installed JAR checks `DamageCause.isDurabilityLoss()`, picks an unbroken armor slot with native RNG, then calls `ItemUtils.decreaseItemStackDurability` directly. No cancellable per-item pre-debit event is exposed there. Managed weapon assets also contain `DurabilityLossOnHit` (e.g. battleaxe 0.45). A correct managed-carrier replacement must account for weapon contact, armor damage, guard, permissible tool use and death loss before disabling any native producer. Neither a post-debit refund nor a universal event was introduced. A complete design must replace every affected debit at its producer and preserve stock/unaﬃxed behavior.
+- **D11 / WA-155:** installed `ColorLight.radius` is a `byte`; `DynamicLight` exposes `getColorLight`/`setColorLight`, and `DynamicLightSystems.Setup` copies `PersistentDynamicLight` into `DynamicLight`. Thus 0.01 m exactness is not available directly from this representation. The radius-to-metre scale and interaction with held light still require calibration and actor-owned composition before any projection can be enabled.
+- **WA-156:** `HytaleGearLoot.scanStockPickup` is a copied-save, protected QA stock transfer and `autoPickup` is for managed equipment projections. Neither is a general currency/material claim path. The installed native `PlayerItemEntityPickupSystem` owns ordinary pickup; `InteractivelyPickupItemEvent` only carries a stack, not a player-specific reach override. No safe allowlisted claim/LOS/capacity transaction exists in this owner for expanded reach, so no radius mutation or synthetic admission was added.
+- **WA-152:** `EarnedReward` and `RpgPlayerState` have no currency field/remainder, and `HytaleEncounterRewards` currently sends XP/insight/mastery through `RpgLoadoutService.awardEarned/awardGenerated`. There is no eligible currency pot to bonus there. Main owner must add durable owner/currency amount and fractional remainder to the **same** deduplicated reward receipt/state before this class can apply D09. Do not pay at pickup or invent a separate mutable counter.

+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear;
+
+import com.hypixel.hytale.component.*;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.component.dependency.*;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.component.query.Query;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.entity.damage.DamageDataComponent;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.inventory.InventoryComponent;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.modules.entity.damage.*;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.universe.PlayerRef;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.universe.world.storage.EntityStore;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.meta.MetaKey;
+import java.util.Set;
+
+/** WA-083: alter the authenticated native block debit before DamageStamina consumes it. */
+public final class NativeAffixBlockCostSystem extends DamageEventSystem {
+    private static final MetaKey<Boolean> APPLIED=Damage.META_REGISTRY.registerMetaObject(
+            ignored->false,false,"Hywind:AffixBlockCostApplied",com.hypixel.hytale.codec.Codec.BOOLEAN);
+
+    @Override public SystemGroup<EntityStore> getGroup(){return DamageModule.get().getInspectDamageGroup();}
+    @Override public Query<EntityStore> getQuery(){return Query.and(PlayerRef.getComponentType(),DamageDataComponent.getComponentType());}
+    @Override public Set<Dependency<EntityStore>> getDependencies(){return Set.of(
+            new SystemDependency<>(Order.BEFORE,DamageSystems.DamageStamina.class));}
+
+    @Override public void handle(int index,ArchetypeChunk<EntityStore> chunk,Store<EntityStore> store,
+                                 CommandBuffer<EntityStore> buffer,Damage damage){
+        if(damage.isCancelled()||!Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED)))return;
+        var actor=chunk.getReferenceTo(index);
+        var data=chunk.getComponent(index,DamageDataComponent.getComponentType());
+        if(data==null||data.getCurrentWielding()==null||data.getCurrentWielding().getStaminaCost()==null)return;
+        var held=InventoryComponent.getItemInHand(store,actor);
+        // CurrentWielding does not expose its source hand. With a utility item active,
+        // attribution to the hotbar item would be ambiguous; leave native cost intact.
+        var utility=store.getComponent(actor,InventoryComponent.Utility.getComponentType());
+        if(utility!=null&&utility.getActiveItem()!=null&&!utility.getActiveItem().isEmpty())return;
+        if(!GearNativeItems.managed(held)||!GearNativeItems.canUse(held,actor,store))return;
+        GearInstance item;
+        try{item=GearNativeItems.read(held);}catch(RuntimeException invalid){return;}
+        var snapshot=GearNativeItems.effects(actor,store).snapshot();
+        if(snapshot.items().stream().noneMatch(valid->valid.identity().equals(item.identity())))return;
+        apply(damage,snapshot.forItem(item.identity()));
+    }
+
+    /** Same mutation used by the ECS adapter; callable with controlled legal snapshots. */
+    public static boolean apply(Damage damage,GearEffectSnapshot guard){
+        if(damage.isCancelled()||!Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED))
+                ||Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(APPLIED)))return false;
+        double reduction=guard.percent(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.BLOCK_COST);
+        if(reduction<=0)return false;
+        float prior=damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER)==null
+                ?1f:damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER);
+        if(!Float.isFinite(prior)||prior<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid native block multiplier");
+        damage.putMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER,(float)(prior*Math.max(0,1-reduction)));
+        damage.putMetaObject(APPLIED,true);
+        return true;
+    }
+}

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..d0e4dc40f52b6b84dc0a8c1384f937845bb1230b

+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear;
+
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.modules.entity.damage.Damage;
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
+import java.math.BigDecimal;
+import java.util.*;
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
+
+class NativeAffixBlockCostSystemTest {
+    private final GearCatalog catalog=GearCatalog.load();
+
+    private GearEffectSnapshot guard(double value){
+        var definition=catalog.affix("WA-083");
+        var roll=new GearInstance.AffixRoll(definition.id(),definition.side(),definition.exclusionGroup(),
+                1,value,new GearRequirements.Gate(1,Map.of()),definition.name(),definition.name());
+        var item=GearInstance.authoredQa(catalog.base("gm.battleaxe_adamantite.h"),UUID.randomUUID(),99,1000,
+                GearRarity.UNCOMMON,List.of(roll),BigDecimal.ZERO);
+        return new GearEffectSnapshot(List.of(item));
+    }
+    private static Damage block(){
+        var damage=new Damage(Damage.NULL_SOURCE,0,10f);
+        damage.putMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED,true);
+        return damage;
+    }
+    @Test void nativeBlockDebitMultiplierIsChangedExactlyOnce(){
+        var snapshot=guard(15);
+        var hit=block();hit.putMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER,2f);
+        assertTrue(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(hit,snapshot));
+        assertEquals(1.7f,hit.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER),.00001f);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(hit,snapshot));
+        assertEquals(1.7f,hit.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER),.00001f);
+    }
+    @Test void noAffixFailedBlockAndCancelledDamageRetainNativeCost(){
+        var noAffix=block();assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(noAffix,GearEffectSnapshot.EMPTY));
+        assertNull(noAffix.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER));
+        var failed=new Damage(Damage.NULL_SOURCE,0,10f);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(failed,guard(15)));
+        assertNull(failed.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER));
+        var cancelled=block();cancelled.setCancelled(true);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(cancelled,guard(15)));
+    }
+}

+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear;
+
+import com.hypixel.hytale.component.*;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.component.dependency.*;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.component.query.Query;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.entity.damage.DamageDataComponent;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.inventory.InventoryComponent;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.modules.entity.damage.*;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.universe.PlayerRef;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.universe.world.storage.EntityStore;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.meta.MetaKey;
+import java.util.Set;
+
+/** WA-083: alter the authenticated native block debit before DamageStamina consumes it. */
+public final class NativeAffixBlockCostSystem extends DamageEventSystem {
+    private static final MetaKey<Boolean> APPLIED=Damage.META_REGISTRY.registerMetaObject(
+            ignored->false,false,"Hywind:AffixBlockCostApplied",com.hypixel.hytale.codec.Codec.BOOLEAN);
+
+    @Override public SystemGroup<EntityStore> getGroup(){return DamageModule.get().getInspectDamageGroup();}
+    @Override public Query<EntityStore> getQuery(){return Query.and(PlayerRef.getComponentType(),DamageDataComponent.getComponentType());}
+    @Override public Set<Dependency<EntityStore>> getDependencies(){return Set.of(
+            new SystemDependency<>(Order.BEFORE,DamageSystems.DamageStamina.class));}
+
+    @Override public void handle(int index,ArchetypeChunk<EntityStore> chunk,Store<EntityStore> store,
+                                 CommandBuffer<EntityStore> buffer,Damage damage){
+        if(damage.isCancelled()||!Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED)))return;
+        var actor=chunk.getReferenceTo(index);
+        var data=chunk.getComponent(index,DamageDataComponent.getComponentType());
+        if(data==null||data.getCurrentWielding()==null||data.getCurrentWielding().getStaminaCost()==null)return;
+        var held=InventoryComponent.getItemInHand(store,actor);
+        // CurrentWielding does not expose its source hand. With a utility item active,
+        // attribution to the hotbar item would be ambiguous; leave native cost intact.
+        var utility=store.getComponent(actor,InventoryComponent.Utility.getComponentType());
+        if(utility!=null&&utility.getActiveItem()!=null&&!utility.getActiveItem().isEmpty())return;
+        if(!GearNativeItems.managed(held)||!GearNativeItems.canUse(held,actor,store))return;
+        GearInstance item;
+        try{item=GearNativeItems.read(held);}catch(RuntimeException invalid){return;}
+        var snapshot=GearNativeItems.effects(actor,store).snapshot();
+        if(snapshot.items().stream().noneMatch(valid->valid.identity().equals(item.identity())))return;
+        apply(damage,snapshot.forItem(item.identity()));
+    }
+
+    /** Same mutation used by the ECS adapter; callable with controlled legal snapshots. */
+    public static boolean apply(Damage damage,GearEffectSnapshot guard){
+        if(damage.isCancelled()||!Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED))
+                ||Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(APPLIED)))return false;
+        double reduction=guard.percent(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.BLOCK_COST);
+        if(reduction<=0)return false;
+        float prior=damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER)==null
+                ?1f:damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER);
+        if(!Float.isFinite(prior)||prior<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid native block multiplier");
+        damage.putMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER,(float)(prior*Math.max(0,1-reduction)));
+        damage.putMetaObject(APPLIED,true);
+        return true;
+    }
+}

+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear;
+
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.modules.entity.damage.Damage;
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
+import java.math.BigDecimal;
+import java.util.*;
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
+
+class NativeAffixBlockCostSystemTest {
+    private final GearCatalog catalog=GearCatalog.load();
+
+    private GearEffectSnapshot guard(double value){
+        var definition=catalog.affix("WA-083");
+        var roll=new GearInstance.AffixRoll(definition.id(),definition.side(),definition.exclusionGroup(),
+                1,value,new GearRequirements.Gate(1,Map.of()),definition.name(),definition.name());
+        var item=GearInstance.authoredQa(catalog.base("gm.battleaxe_adamantite.h"),UUID.randomUUID(),99,1000,
+                GearRarity.UNCOMMON,List.of(roll),BigDecimal.ZERO);
+        return new GearEffectSnapshot(List.of(item));
+    }
+    private static Damage block(){
+        var damage=new Damage(Damage.NULL_SOURCE,0,10f);
+        damage.putMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED,true);
+        return damage;
+    }
+    @Test void nativeBlockDebitMultiplierIsChangedExactlyOnce(){
+        var snapshot=guard(15);
+        var hit=block();hit.putMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER,2f);
+        assertTrue(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(hit,snapshot));
+        assertEquals(1.7f,hit.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER),.00001f);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(hit,snapshot));
+        assertEquals(1.7f,hit.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER),.00001f);
+    }
+    @Test void noAffixFailedBlockAndCancelledDamageRetainNativeCost(){
+        var noAffix=block();assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(noAffix,GearEffectSnapshot.EMPTY));
+        assertNull(noAffix.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER));
+        var failed=new Damage(Damage.NULL_SOURCE,0,10f);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(failed,guard(15)));
+        assertNull(failed.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER));
+        var cancelled=block();cancelled.setCancelled(true);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(cancelled,guard(15)));
+    }
+}

+# Native worker result (2026-09-30)
+
+## Changed files
+
+- `src/main/java/com/inigmasgames/hytalerpg/gear/NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.java` — a native `DamageEventSystem` ordered before `DamageSystems.DamageStamina`. For an authenticated block with a valid, active held item, it applies WA-083 to the existing `Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER` once. An active utility item is an explicit fail-closed ambiguity because `DamageDataComponent.getCurrentWielding()` does not expose its source hand.
+- `src/test/java/com/inigmasgames/hytalerpg/gear/NativeAffixBlockCostSystemTest.java` — controlled snapshot through the same admission method used by the native system: positive multiplier, no-affix control, unblocked and canceled negative cases, repeated callback. Uses a battleaxe with an authored native guard profile, not a shield that is presently unmapped.
+
+## Exact ID status
+
+- **WA-083: partial native adapter only.** It is not registered, its capability gate remains closed, and this test does not prove the complete ECS handoff. No ID in this worker's scope is claimed fully complete or production enabled.
+- WA-154 has an existing `GearRequirements.combine` implementation and `GearFoundationTest`; this worker did not change it or claim connected proof.
+- WA-008/014/015/016/081/082/084/138/152/153/155/156 remain unfinished. Do not count these as FUNCTIONAL from this result.
+
+## Native evidence and exact wiring request
+
+- Installed `pre-release` server `HytaleServer.jar` was inspected with `javap`. `DamageSystems.DamageStamina` runs in `DamageModule.getInspectDamageGroup()`, tests `Damage.BLOCKED`, computes the base block stamina cost, multiplies by `Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER`, then calls `EntityStatMap.subtractStatValue`. This confirms the pre-debit seam used by `NativeAffixBlockCostSystem`.
+- Main owner: after confirming complete guard-source attribution and testing the registered ECS path, add `getEntityStoreRegistry().registerSystem(new com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.NativeAffixBlockCostSystem());` beside the other damage systems in `HyArpgPlugin.java` (near `ReactionObserver`). Ordering is declared in the system dependency. Retain `GearAffixRuntime.ENABLED` until all production cases and tests pass; then include WA-083 through the main owner's capability decision. Do not enable WA-083 merely because the adapter compiles.
+- Main owner: shield bindings in `rpg/gear/native-bindings-v1.json` are presently `BLOCKED_WITH_REASON`; `gm.shield_copper.h` has no managed carrier. A complete WA-083 requires mapped shield carriers and an authoritative way to identify the source hand for `getCurrentWielding()`, including utility/offhand. The adapter currently fails closed whenever a utility item is active; it must not be presented as covering shields.
+- Combat owner: WA-008 needs immutable action plus animation timeline profiles at accepted native chain start; WA-014 needs authored sweep geometry, terrain clipping and shared victim ledger; WA-015/016 need speed and accumulated path-distance changes in `ManagedGearProjectile`; WA-138 needs real Defense rating timed modifier, lock and native Filter integration. WA-084 requires a preserved ordinary and critical component pair on the hit envelope before Filter; current `HytaleDamageMetadata` contains only one premitigation scalar. WA-138/084 cannot infer these values from `Damage.getAmount()`.
+- Status/resources owner: WA-081 must project the strongest Slow after reduction into one exact movement modifier; the current `HytaleAreaStatuses.synchronize` maps Slow to discrete `RPG_Chill_*` assets, so simply scaling the status value would not prove a 40% to 32% native movement outcome. WA-082 requires an attacker-classified hostile displacement request before the safe collision solver. Self movement must retain its baseline. WA-083 native blocked-hit debit must be checked against the resources owner's event ordering and guard break.
+- Main owner: WA-138 Twin Assault is **not** this ID; Twin Assault is the separate dual-wield action boundary described in D03/§5.4. The requested WA-138 is Riveting/Armor Break as its individual card states. Genuine offhand contact still needs an audited registered profile and a source-item snapshot, not a scalar extra hit.
+
+## Proven missing boundaries
+
+- **D10 / WA-153:** `DamageSystems.DamageArmor` on the installed JAR checks `DamageCause.isDurabilityLoss()`, picks an unbroken armor slot with native RNG, then calls `ItemUtils.decreaseItemStackDurability` directly. No cancellable per-item pre-debit event is exposed there. Managed weapon assets also contain `DurabilityLossOnHit` (e.g. battleaxe 0.45). A correct managed-carrier replacement must account for weapon contact, armor damage, guard, permissible tool use and death loss before disabling any native producer. Neither a post-debit refund nor a universal event was introduced. A complete design must replace every affected debit at its producer and preserve stock/unaﬃxed behavior.
+- **D11 / WA-155:** installed `ColorLight.radius` is a `byte`; `DynamicLight` exposes `getColorLight`/`setColorLight`, and `DynamicLightSystems.Setup` copies `PersistentDynamicLight` into `DynamicLight`. Thus 0.01 m exactness is not available directly from this representation. The radius-to-metre scale and interaction with held light still require calibration and actor-owned composition before any projection can be enabled.
+- **WA-156:** `HytaleGearLoot.scanStockPickup` is a copied-save, protected QA stock transfer and `autoPickup` is for managed equipment projections. Neither is a general currency/material claim path. The installed native `PlayerItemEntityPickupSystem` owns ordinary pickup; `InteractivelyPickupItemEvent` only carries a stack, not a player-specific reach override. No safe allowlisted claim/LOS/capacity transaction exists in this owner for expanded reach, so no radius mutation or synthetic admission was added.
+- **WA-152:** `EarnedReward` and `RpgPlayerState` have no currency field/remainder, and `HytaleEncounterRewards` currently sends XP/insight/mastery through `RpgLoadoutService.awardEarned/awardGenerated`. There is no eligible currency pot to bonus there. Main owner must add durable owner/currency amount and fractional remainder to the **same** deduplicated reward receipt/state before this class can apply D09. Do not pay at pickup or invent a separate mutable counter.
+

+
+- `javap` public API/bytecode reads were performed against the installed server JAR. `git diff --check` found no whitespace errors in the new files. Gradle, server launch, authentication and connected QA were not run as directed. Main agent must compile and run `NativeAffixBlockCostSystemTest`, then registered positive/control/negative ECS tests before changing the capability gate or audit count.

+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear;
+
+import com.hypixel.hytale.component.*;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.component.dependency.*;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.component.query.Query;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.entity.damage.DamageDataComponent;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.inventory.InventoryComponent;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.modules.entity.damage.*;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.universe.PlayerRef;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.universe.world.storage.EntityStore;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.meta.MetaKey;
+import java.util.Set;
+
+/** WA-083: alter the authenticated native block debit before DamageStamina consumes it. */
+public final class NativeAffixBlockCostSystem extends DamageEventSystem {
+    private static final MetaKey<Boolean> APPLIED=Damage.META_REGISTRY.registerMetaObject(
+            ignored->false,false,"Hywind:AffixBlockCostApplied",com.hypixel.hytale.codec.Codec.BOOLEAN);
+
+    @Override public SystemGroup<EntityStore> getGroup(){return DamageModule.get().getInspectDamageGroup();}
+    @Override public Query<EntityStore> getQuery(){return Query.and(PlayerRef.getComponentType(),DamageDataComponent.getComponentType());}
+    @Override public Set<Dependency<EntityStore>> getDependencies(){return Set.of(
+            new SystemDependency<>(Order.BEFORE,DamageSystems.DamageStamina.class));}
+
+    @Override public void handle(int index,ArchetypeChunk<EntityStore> chunk,Store<EntityStore> store,
+                                 CommandBuffer<EntityStore> buffer,Damage damage){
+        if(damage.isCancelled()||!Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED)))return;
+        var actor=chunk.getReferenceTo(index);
+        var data=chunk.getComponent(index,DamageDataComponent.getComponentType());
+        if(data==null||data.getCurrentWielding()==null||data.getCurrentWielding().getStaminaCost()==null)return;
+        var held=InventoryComponent.getItemInHand(store,actor);
+        // CurrentWielding does not expose its source hand. With a utility item active,
+        // attribution to the hotbar item would be ambiguous; leave native cost intact.
+        var utility=store.getComponent(actor,InventoryComponent.Utility.getComponentType());
+        if(utility!=null&&utility.getActiveItem()!=null&&!utility.getActiveItem().isEmpty())return;
+        if(!GearNativeItems.managed(held)||!GearNativeItems.canUse(held,actor,store))return;
+        GearInstance item;
+        try{item=GearNativeItems.read(held);}catch(RuntimeException invalid){return;}
+        var snapshot=GearNativeItems.effects(actor,store).snapshot();
+        if(snapshot.items().stream().noneMatch(valid->valid.identity().equals(item.identity())))return;
+        apply(damage,snapshot.forItem(item.identity()));
+    }
+
+    /** Same mutation used by the ECS adapter; callable with controlled legal snapshots. */
+    public static boolean apply(Damage damage,GearEffectSnapshot guard){
+        if(damage.isCancelled()||!Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED))
+                ||Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(APPLIED)))return false;
+        double reduction=guard.percent(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.BLOCK_COST);
+        if(reduction<=0)return false;
+        float prior=damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER)==null
+                ?1f:damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER);
+        if(!Float.isFinite(prior)||prior<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid native block multiplier");
+        damage.putMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER,(float)(prior*Math.max(0,1-reduction)));
+        damage.putMetaObject(APPLIED,true);
+        return true;
+    }
+}

+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear;
+
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.modules.entity.damage.Damage;
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
+import java.math.BigDecimal;
+import java.util.*;
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
+
+class NativeAffixBlockCostSystemTest {
+    private final GearCatalog catalog=GearCatalog.load();
+
+    private GearEffectSnapshot guard(double value){
+        var definition=catalog.affix("WA-083");
+        var roll=new GearInstance.AffixRoll(definition.id(),definition.side(),definition.exclusionGroup(),
+                1,value,new GearRequirements.Gate(1,Map.of()),definition.name(),definition.name());
+        var item=GearInstance.authoredQa(catalog.base("gm.battleaxe_adamantite.h"),UUID.randomUUID(),99,1000,
+                GearRarity.UNCOMMON,List.of(roll),BigDecimal.ZERO);
+        return new GearEffectSnapshot(List.of(item));
+    }
+    private static Damage block(){
+        var damage=new Damage(Damage.NULL_SOURCE,0,10f);
+        damage.putMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED,true);
+        return damage;
+    }
+    @Test void nativeBlockDebitMultiplierIsChangedExactlyOnce(){
+        var snapshot=guard(15);
+        var hit=block();hit.putMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER,2f);
+        assertTrue(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(hit,snapshot));
+        assertEquals(1.7f,hit.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER),.00001f);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(hit,snapshot));
+        assertEquals(1.7f,hit.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER),.00001f);
+    }
+    @Test void noAffixFailedBlockAndCancelledDamageRetainNativeCost(){
+        var noAffix=block();assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(noAffix,GearEffectSnapshot.EMPTY));
+        assertNull(noAffix.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER));
+        var failed=new Damage(Damage.NULL_SOURCE,0,10f);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(failed,guard(15)));
+        assertNull(failed.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER));
+        var cancelled=block();cancelled.setCancelled(true);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(cancelled,guard(15)));
+    }
+}

+                                 CommandBuffer<EntityStore> buffer,Damage damage){
+        if(damage.isCancelled()||!Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED)))return;
+        var actor=chunk.getReferenceTo(index);
+        var data=chunk.getComponent(index,DamageDataComponent.getComponentType());
+        if(data==null||data.getCurrentWielding()==null||data.getCurrentWielding().getStaminaCost()==null)return;
+        var held=InventoryComponent.getItemInHand(store,actor);
+        // CurrentWielding does not expose its source hand. With a utility item active,
+        // attribution to the hotbar item would be ambiguous; leave native cost intact.
+        var utility=store.getComponent(actor,InventoryComponent.Utility.getComponentType());
+        if(utility!=null&&utility.getActiveItem()!=null&&!utility.getActiveItem().isEmpty())return;
+        if(!GearNativeItems.managed(held)||!GearNativeItems.canUse(held,actor,store))return;
+        GearInstance item;
+        try{item=GearNativeItems.read(held);}catch(RuntimeException invalid){return;}
+        var snapshot=GearNativeItems.effects(actor,store).snapshot();
+        if(snapshot.items().stream().noneMatch(valid->valid.identity().equals(item.identity())))return;
+        apply(damage,snapshot.forItem(item.identity()));
+    }
+
+    /** Same mutation used by the ECS adapter; callable with controlled legal snapshots. */
+    public static boolean apply(Damage damage,GearEffectSnapshot guard){
+        if(damage.isCancelled()||!Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED))
+                ||Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(APPLIED)))return false;
+        double reduction=guard.percent(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.BLOCK_COST);
+        if(reduction<=0)return false;
+        float prior=damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER)==null
+                ?1f:damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER);
+        if(!Float.isFinite(prior)||prior<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid native block multiplier");
+        damage.putMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER,(float)(prior*Math.max(0,1-reduction)));
+        damage.putMetaObject(APPLIED,true);
+        return true;
+    }
+}

+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear;
+
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.modules.entity.damage.Damage;
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
+import java.math.BigDecimal;
+import java.util.*;
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
+
+class NativeAffixBlockCostSystemTest {
+    private final GearCatalog catalog=GearCatalog.load();
+
+    private GearEffectSnapshot guard(double value){
+        var definition=catalog.affix("WA-083");
+        var roll=new GearInstance.AffixRoll(definition.id(),definition.side(),definition.exclusionGroup(),
+                1,value,new GearRequirements.Gate(1,Map.of()),definition.name(),definition.name());
+        var item=GearInstance.authoredQa(catalog.base("gm.battleaxe_adamantite.h"),UUID.randomUUID(),99,1000,
+                GearRarity.UNCOMMON,List.of(roll),BigDecimal.ZERO);
+        return new GearEffectSnapshot(List.of(item));
+    }
+    private static Damage block(){
+        var damage=new Damage(Damage.NULL_SOURCE,0,10f);
+        damage.putMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED,true);
+        return damage;
+    }
+    @Test void nativeBlockDebitMultiplierIsChangedExactlyOnce(){
+        var snapshot=guard(15);
+        var hit=block();hit.putMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER,2f);
+        assertTrue(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(hit,snapshot));
+        assertEquals(1.7f,hit.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER),.00001f);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(hit,snapshot));
+        assertEquals(1.7f,hit.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER),.00001f);
+    }
+    @Test void noAffixFailedBlockAndCancelledDamageRetainNativeCost(){
+        var noAffix=block();assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(noAffix,GearEffectSnapshot.EMPTY));
+        assertNull(noAffix.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER));
+        var failed=new Damage(Damage.NULL_SOURCE,0,10f);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(failed,guard(15)));
+        assertNull(failed.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER));
+        var cancelled=block();cancelled.setCancelled(true);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(cancelled,guard(15)));
+    }
+}

+## Changed files
+
+- `src/main/java/com/inigmasgames/hytalerpg/gear/NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.java` — a native `DamageEventSystem` ordered before `DamageSystems.DamageStamina`. For an authenticated block with a valid, active held item, it applies WA-083 to the existing `Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER` once. An active utility item is an explicit fail-closed ambiguity because `DamageDataComponent.getCurrentWielding()` does not expose its source hand.

Uses a battleaxe with an authored native guard profile, not a shield that is presently unmapped.

+
+- **WA-083: partial native adapter only.** It is not registered, its capability gate remains closed, and this test does not prove the complete ECS handoff. No ID in this worker's scope is claimed fully complete or production enabled.
+- WA-154 has an existing `GearRequirements.combine` implementation and `GearFoundationTest`; this worker did not change it or claim connected proof.
+- WA-008/014/015/016/081/082/084/138/152/153/155/156 remain unfinished. Do not count these as FUNCTIONAL from this result.

+## Native evidence and exact wiring request
+

This confirms the pre-debit seam used by `NativeAffixBlockCostSystem`.
+- Main owner: after confirming complete guard-source attribution and testing the registered ECS path, add `getEntityStoreRegistry().registerSystem(new com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.NativeAffixBlockCostSystem());` beside the other damage systems in `HyArpgPlugin.java` (near `ReactionObserver`). Ordering is declared in the system dependency. Retain `GearAffixRuntime.ENABLED` until all production cases and tests pass; then include WA-083 through the main owner's capability decision. Do not enable WA-083 merely because the adapter compiles.
+- Main owner: shield bindings in `rpg/gear/native-bindings-v1.json` are presently `BLOCKED_WITH_REASON`; `gm.shield_copper.h` has no managed carrier. A complete WA-083 requires mapped shield carriers and an authoritative way to identify the source hand for `getCurrentWielding()`, including utility/offhand. The adapter currently fails closed whenever a utility item is active; it must not be presented as covering shields.
+- Combat owner: WA-008 needs immutable action plus animation timeline profiles at accepted native chain start; WA-014 needs authored sweep geometry, terrain clipping and shared victim ledger; WA-015/016 need speed and accumulated path-distance changes in `ManagedGearProjectile`; WA-138 needs real Defense rating timed modifier, lock and native Filter integration. WA-084 requires a preserved ordinary and critical component pair on the hit envelope before Filter; current `HytaleDamageMetadata` contains only one premitigation scalar. WA-138/084 cannot infer these values from `Damage.getAmount()`.
+- Status/resources owner: WA-081 must project the strongest Slow after reduction into one exact movement modifier; the current `HytaleAreaStatuses.synchronize` maps Slow to discrete `RPG_Chill_*` assets, so simply scaling the status value would not prove a 40% to 32% native movement outcome. WA-082 requires an attacker-classified hostile displacement request before the safe collision solver. Self movement must retain its baseline. WA-083 native blocked-hit debit must be checked against the resources owner's event ordering and guard break.
+- Main owner: WA-138 Twin Assault is **not** this ID; Twin Assault is the separate dual-wield action boundary described in D03/§5.4. The requested WA-138 is Riveting/Armor Break as its individual card states. Genuine offhand contact still needs an audited registered profile and a source-item snapshot, not a scalar extra hit.
+
+## Proven missing boundaries
+
+- **D10 / WA-153:** `DamageSystems.DamageArmor` on the installed JAR checks `DamageCause.isDurabilityLoss()`, picks an unbroken armor slot with native RNG, then calls `ItemUtils.decreaseItemStackDurability` directly. No cancellable per-item pre-debit event is exposed there. Managed weapon assets also contain `DurabilityLossOnHit` (e.g. battleaxe 0.45). A correct managed-carrier replacement must account for weapon contact, armor damage, guard, permissible tool use and death loss before disabling any native producer. Neither a post-debit refund nor a universal event was introduced. A complete design must replace every affected debit at its producer and preserve stock/unaﬃxed behavior.
+- **D11 / WA-155:** installed `ColorLight.radius` is a `byte`; `DynamicLight` exposes `getColorLight`/`setColorLight`, and `DynamicLightSystems.Setup` copies `PersistentDynamicLight` into `DynamicLight`. Thus 0.01 m exactness is not available directly from this representation. The radius-to-metre scale and interaction with held light still require calibration and actor-owned composition before any projection can be enabled.
+- **D03 / WA-008:** installed `InteractionChain` exposes `getTimeShift`/`setTimeShift` and `isPredicted`, but this alone does not rescale first/third-person animation speed or prove a synchronized client-predicted chain. Managed action roots currently reference stock timelines. A bounded interaction plus item-animation profile generator, carrier binding before chain acceptance, and native positive/control tests are still required. WA-014/015/016 likewise remain at their managed contact/projectile owners.
+- **WA-156:** `HytaleGearLoot.scanStockPickup` is a copied-save, protected QA stock transfer and `autoPickup` is for managed equipment projections. Neither is a general currency/material claim path. The installed native `PlayerItemEntityPickupSystem` owns ordinary pickup; `InteractivelyPickupItemEvent` only carries a stack, not a player-specific reach override. No safe allowlisted claim/LOS/capacity transaction exists in this owner for expanded reach, so no radius mutation or synthetic admission was added.
+- **WA-152:** `EarnedReward` and `RpgPlayerState` have no currency field/remainder, and `HytaleEncounterRewards` currently sends XP/insight/mastery through `RpgLoadoutService.awardEarned/awardGenerated`. There is no eligible currency pot to bonus there. Main owner must add durable owner/currency amount and fractional remainder to the **same** deduplicated reward receipt/state before this class can apply D09. Do not pay at pickup or invent a separate mutable counter.

+++ b/src/main/java/com/inigmasgames/hytalerpg/gear/NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.java
@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear;
+
+import com.hypixel.hytale.component.*;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.component.dependency.*;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.component.query.Query;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.entity.damage.DamageDataComponent;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.inventory.InventoryComponent;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.modules.entity.damage.*;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.universe.PlayerRef;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.universe.world.storage.EntityStore;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.meta.MetaKey;
+import java.util.Set;
+
+/** WA-083: alter the authenticated native block debit before DamageStamina consumes it. */
+public final class NativeAffixBlockCostSystem extends DamageEventSystem {
+    private static final MetaKey<Boolean> APPLIED=Damage.META_REGISTRY.registerMetaObject(
+            ignored->false,false,"Hywind:AffixBlockCostApplied",com.hypixel.hytale.codec.Codec.BOOLEAN);
+
+    @Override public SystemGroup<EntityStore> getGroup(){return DamageModule.get().getInspectDamageGroup();}
+    @Override public Query<EntityStore> getQuery(){return Query.and(PlayerRef.getComponentType(),DamageDataComponent.getComponentType());}
+    @Override public Set<Dependency<EntityStore>> getDependencies(){return Set.of(
+            new SystemDependency<>(Order.BEFORE,DamageSystems.DamageStamina.class));}
+
+    @Override public void handle(int index,ArchetypeChunk<EntityStore> chunk,Store<EntityStore> store,
+                                 CommandBuffer<EntityStore> buffer,Damage damage){
+        if(damage.isCancelled()||!Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED)))return;
+        var actor=chunk.getReferenceTo(index);
+        var data=chunk.getComponent(index,DamageDataComponent.getComponentType());
+        if(data==null||data.getCurrentWielding()==null||data.getCurrentWielding().getStaminaCost()==null)return;
+        var held=InventoryComponent.getItemInHand(store,actor);
+        // CurrentWielding does not expose its source hand. With a utility item active,
+        // attribution to the hotbar item would be ambiguous; leave native cost intact.
+        var utility=store.getComponent(actor,InventoryComponent.Utility.getComponentType());
+        if(utility!=null&&utility.getActiveItem()!=null&&!utility.getActiveItem().isEmpty())return;
+        if(!GearNativeItems.managed(held)||!GearNativeItems.canUse(held,actor,store))return;
+        GearInstance item;
+        try{item=GearNativeItems.read(held);}catch(RuntimeException invalid){return;}
+        var snapshot=GearNativeItems.effects(actor,store).snapshot();
+        if(snapshot.items().stream().noneMatch(valid->valid.identity().equals(item.identity())))return;
+        apply(damage,snapshot.forItem(item.identity()));
+    }
+
+    /** Same mutation used by the ECS adapter; callable with controlled legal snapshots. */
+    public static boolean apply(Damage damage,GearEffectSnapshot guard){
+        if(damage.isCancelled()||!Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED))
+                ||Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(APPLIED)))return false;
+        double reduction=guard.percent(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.BLOCK_COST);
+        if(reduction<=0)return false;
+        float prior=damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER)==null
+                ?1f:damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER);
+        if(!Float.isFinite(prior)||prior<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid native block multiplier");
+        damage.putMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER,(float)(prior*Math.max(0,1-reduction)));
+        damage.putMetaObject(APPLIED,true);
+        return true;
+    }
+}
diff --git a/src/test/java/com/inigmasgames/hytalerpg/gear/NativeAffixBlockCostSystemTest.java b/src/test/java/com/inigmasgames/hytalerpg/gear/NativeAffixBlockCostSystemTest.java

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..d0e4dc40f52b6b84dc0a8c1384f937845bb1230b

+++ b/src/test/java/com/inigmasgames/hytalerpg/gear/NativeAffixBlockCostSystemTest.java

+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear;
+
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.modules.entity.damage.Damage;
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
+import java.math.BigDecimal;
+import java.util.*;
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
+
+class NativeAffixBlockCostSystemTest {
+    private final GearCatalog catalog=GearCatalog.load();
+
+    private GearEffectSnapshot guard(double value){
+        var definition=catalog.affix("WA-083");
+        var roll=new GearInstance.AffixRoll(definition.id(),definition.side(),definition.exclusionGroup(),
+                1,value,new GearRequirements.Gate(1,Map.of()),definition.name(),definition.name());
+        var item=GearInstance.authoredQa(catalog.base("gm.battleaxe_adamantite.h"),UUID.randomUUID(),99,1000,
+                GearRarity.UNCOMMON,List.of(roll),BigDecimal.ZERO);
+        return new GearEffectSnapshot(List.of(item));
+    }
+    private static Damage block(){
+        var damage=new Damage(Damage.NULL_SOURCE,0,10f);
+        damage.putMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED,true);
+        return damage;
+    }
+    @Test void nativeBlockDebitMultiplierIsChangedExactlyOnce(){
+        var snapshot=guard(15);
+        var hit=block();hit.putMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER,2f);
+        assertTrue(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(hit,snapshot));
+        assertEquals(1.7f,hit.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER),.00001f);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(hit,snapshot));
+        assertEquals(1.7f,hit.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER),.00001f);
+    }
+    @Test void noAffixFailedBlockAndCancelledDamageRetainNativeCost(){
+        var noAffix=block();assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(noAffix,GearEffectSnapshot.EMPTY));
+        assertNull(noAffix.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER));
+        var failed=new Damage(Damage.NULL_SOURCE,0,10f);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(failed,guard(15)));
+        assertNull(failed.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER));
+        var cancelled=block();cancelled.setCancelled(true);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(cancelled,guard(15)));
+    }
+}

An active utility item is an explicit fail-closed ambiguity because `DamageDataComponent.getCurrentWielding()` does not expose its source hand.

Uses a battleaxe with an authored native guard profile, not a shield that is presently unmapped.

This confirms the pre-debit seam used by `NativeAffixBlockCostSystem`.

Ordering is declared in the system dependency. Retain `GearAffixRuntime.ENABLED` until all production cases and tests pass; then include WA-083 through the main owner's capability decision. Do not enable WA-083 merely because the adapter compiles.
+- Main owner: shield bindings in `rpg/gear/native-bindings-v1.json` are presently `BLOCKED_WITH_REASON`; `gm.shield_copper.h` has no managed carrier. The adapter currently fails closed whenever a utility item is active; it must not be presented as covering shields.

+## Proven missing boundaries
+
+- **D10 / WA-153:** `DamageSystems.DamageArmor` on the installed JAR checks `DamageCause.isDurabilityLoss()`, picks an unbroken armor slot with native RNG, then calls `ItemUtils.decreaseItemStackDurability` directly. No cancellable per-item pre-debit event is exposed there. Managed weapon assets also contain `DurabilityLossOnHit` (e.g. battleaxe 0.45). A correct managed-carrier replacement must account for weapon contact, armor damage, guard, permissible tool use and death loss before disabling any native producer. Neither a post-debit refund nor a universal event was introduced. A complete design must replace every affected debit at its producer and preserve stock/unaffixed behavior.
+- **D11 / WA-155:** installed `ColorLight.radius` is a `byte`; `DynamicLight` exposes `getColorLight`/`setColorLight`, and `DynamicLightSystems.Setup` copies `PersistentDynamicLight` into `DynamicLight`. Thus 0.01 m exactness is not available directly from this representation. The radius-to-metre scale and interaction with held light still require calibration and actor-owned composition before any projection can be enabled.
+- **D03 / WA-008:** installed `InteractionChain` exposes `getTimeShift`/`setTimeShift` and `isPredicted`, but this alone does not rescale first/third-person animation speed or prove a synchronized client-predicted chain. Managed action roots currently reference stock timelines. A bounded interaction plus item-animation profile generator, carrier binding before chain acceptance, and native positive/control tests are still required. WA-014/015/016 likewise remain at their managed contact/projectile owners.
+- **WA-156:** `HytaleGearLoot.scanStockPickup` is a copied-save, protected QA stock transfer and `autoPickup` is for managed equipment projections. Neither is a general currency/material claim path. The installed native `PlayerItemEntityPickupSystem` owns ordinary pickup; `InteractivelyPickupItemEvent` only carries a stack, not a player-specific reach override. No safe allowlisted claim/LOS/capacity transaction exists in this owner for expanded reach, so no radius mutation or synthetic admission was added.
+- **WA-152:** `EarnedReward` and `RpgPlayerState` have no currency field/remainder, and `HytaleEncounterRewards` currently sends XP/insight/mastery through `RpgLoadoutService.awardEarned/awardGenerated`. There is no eligible currency pot to bonus there. Main owner must add durable owner/currency amount and fractional remainder to the **same** deduplicated reward receipt/state before this class can apply D09. Do not pay at pickup or invent a separate mutable counter.

Gradle, server launch, authentication and connected QA were not run as directed. +package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear;
+
+import com.hypixel.hytale.component.*;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.component.dependency.*;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.component.query.Query;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.entity.damage.DamageDataComponent;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.inventory.InventoryComponent;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.modules.entity.damage.*;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.universe.PlayerRef;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.universe.world.storage.EntityStore;
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.meta.MetaKey;
+import java.util.Set;
+
+/** WA-083: alter the authenticated native block debit before DamageStamina consumes it. */
+public final class NativeAffixBlockCostSystem extends DamageEventSystem {
+    private static final MetaKey<Boolean> APPLIED=Damage.META_REGISTRY.registerMetaObject(
+            ignored->false,false,"Hywind:AffixBlockCostApplied",com.hypixel.hytale.codec.Codec.BOOLEAN);
+
+    @Override public SystemGroup<EntityStore> getGroup(){return DamageModule.get().getInspectDamageGroup();}
+    @Override public Query<EntityStore> getQuery(){return Query.and(PlayerRef.getComponentType(),DamageDataComponent.getComponentType());}
+    @Override public Set<Dependency<EntityStore>> getDependencies(){return Set.of(
+            new SystemDependency<>(Order.BEFORE,DamageSystems.DamageStamina.class));}
+
+    @Override public void handle(int index,ArchetypeChunk<EntityStore> chunk,Store<EntityStore> store,
+                                 CommandBuffer<EntityStore> buffer,Damage damage){
+        if(damage.isCancelled()||!Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED)))return;
+        var actor=chunk.getReferenceTo(index);
+        var data=chunk.getComponent(index,DamageDataComponent.getComponentType());
+        if(data==null||data.getCurrentWielding()==null||data.getCurrentWielding().getStaminaCost()==null)return;
+        var held=InventoryComponent.getItemInHand(store,actor);
+        // CurrentWielding does not expose its source hand. With a utility item active,
+        // attribution to the hotbar item would be ambiguous; leave native cost intact.
+        var utility=store.getComponent(actor,InventoryComponent.Utility.getComponentType());
+        if(utility!=null&&utility.getActiveItem()!=null&&!utility.getActiveItem().isEmpty())return;
+        if(!GearNativeItems.managed(held)||!GearNativeItems.canUse(held,actor,store))return;
+        GearInstance item;
+        try{item=GearNativeItems.read(held);}catch(RuntimeException invalid){return;}
+        var snapshot=GearNativeItems.effects(actor,store).snapshot();
+        if(snapshot.items().stream().noneMatch(valid->valid.identity().equals(item.identity())))return;
+        apply(damage,snapshot.forItem(item.identity()));
+    }
+
+    /** Same mutation used by the ECS adapter; callable with controlled legal snapshots. */
+    public static boolean apply(Damage damage,GearEffectSnapshot guard){
+        if(damage.isCancelled()||!Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED))
+                ||Boolean.TRUE.equals(damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(APPLIED)))return false;
+        double reduction=guard.percent(GearEffectSnapshot.Operator.BLOCK_COST);
+        if(reduction<=0)return false;
+        float prior=damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER)==null
+                ?1f:damage.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER);
+        if(!Float.isFinite(prior)||prior<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid native block multiplier");
+        damage.putMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER,(float)(prior*Math.max(0,1-reduction)));
+        damage.putMetaObject(APPLIED,true);
+        return true;
+    }
+}

+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear;
+
+import com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.modules.entity.damage.Damage;
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
+import java.math.BigDecimal;
+import java.util.*;
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
+
+class NativeAffixBlockCostSystemTest {
+    private final GearCatalog catalog=GearCatalog.load();
+
+    private GearEffectSnapshot guard(double value){
+        var definition=catalog.affix("WA-083");
+        var roll=new GearInstance.AffixRoll(definition.id(),definition.side(),definition.exclusionGroup(),
+                1,value,new GearRequirements.Gate(1,Map.of()),definition.name(),definition.name());
+        var item=GearInstance.authoredQa(catalog.base("gm.battleaxe_adamantite.h"),UUID.randomUUID(),99,1000,
+                GearRarity.UNCOMMON,List.of(roll),BigDecimal.ZERO);
+        return new GearEffectSnapshot(List.of(item));
+    }
+    private static Damage block(){
+        var damage=new Damage(Damage.NULL_SOURCE,0,10f);
+        damage.putMetaObject(Damage.BLOCKED,true);
+        return damage;
+    }
+    @Test void nativeBlockDebitMultiplierIsChangedExactlyOnce(){
+        var snapshot=guard(15);
+        var hit=block();hit.putMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER,2f);
+        assertTrue(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(hit,snapshot));
+        assertEquals(1.7f,hit.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER),.00001f);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(hit,snapshot));
+        assertEquals(1.7f,hit.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER),.00001f);
+    }
+    @Test void noAffixFailedBlockAndCancelledDamageRetainNativeCost(){
+        var noAffix=block();assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(noAffix,GearEffectSnapshot.EMPTY));
+        assertNull(noAffix.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER));
+        var failed=new Damage(Damage.NULL_SOURCE,0,10f);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(failed,guard(15)));
+        assertNull(failed.getIfPresentMetaObject(Damage.STAMINA_DRAIN_MULTIPLIER));
+        var cancelled=block();cancelled.setCancelled(true);
+        assertFalse(NativeAffixBlockCostSystem.apply(cancelled,guard(15)));
+    }
